rationale: The graph is dense and strongly structured (density 0.015, avg_degree 88.28, clustering_coeff 0.5329, modularity 0.5194 over 26 communities) while the attribute side is narrow and template-heavy (feature_dim 10, feature_sparsity 0.4803, feature_dup_rate 0.489). That asymmetry is what makes attr_struct_mismatch the primary view: both modalities are individually well formed, so a cross-modal rank divergence is meaningful rather than noise, and its landmarker has by far the widest usable spread (std 0.2454, p50 0.3138 rising to p95 0.7991 and p99 0.9141). homophily_violation follows because homophily 0.7492 establishes neighbor agreement as a reliable norm on this graph, so departures from it carry information; its tail separates cleanly (p50 0.3628 vs p99 0.8410). It is preferred over local_affinity, which tests essentially the same neighbor-agreement mechanism with a weaker tail (p99 0.6969), so running both would be redundant rather than complementary. reconstruction adds the one learned, jointly attribute-and-structure view: with feature_dim 10 and dup_rate 0.489 an autoencoder fits the template mass very tightly, which is exactly the shape the preview shows, a compressed body (p50 0.0532, p95 0.1075) broken by a sharp small tail (p99 0.2539, a 2.4x jump), and the preview is credited with rank correlation 0.87 to the full run. community closes the set with a purely structural residual that neither feature-based view supplies; modularity 0.5194 and clustering 0.5329 confirm the partition is real, and its scores separate (p50 0.2295 vs p99 0.7341). Excluded: density is degenerate here (p50, p90 and p95 all 0.0), which is expected since kNN local density carries no signal at avg_degree 88.28 with dup_rate 0.489; conformity is saturated rather than discriminative (p50 0.8696 with p90 to p99 spanning only 0.9357 to 0.9686), so despite qualifying on dup_rate it cannot rank nodes; spectral is weak (p99 0.5512) and the small spectral_gap 0.132 means the high-frequency band is not cleanly isolated; contrastive is unattractive because with avg_degree 88.28 and clustering_coeff 0.5329 sampled subgraph views overlap heavily and cross-view agreement flattens; adversarial and one_class both compress a 10-dimensional, half-duplicated feature space toward a single template-dominated center or manifold, which is the wrong bias when anomalies may themselves be feature-space in-liers.
